title: headless-agent-runtimes.md cites the Haiku 5.5 price fact at ci-and-headless.md:91, which is another fact
goal: each citation of a ci-and-headless.md price fact in kb/public/agents/headless-agent-runtimes.md names the line of kb/public/claude/ci-and-headless.md that holds that price fact

run: import re, sys; art = open("kb/public/agents/headless-agent-runtimes.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines(); src = open("kb/public/claude/ci-and-headless.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines(); bad = [str(i) + "->:" + (n[0] or n[1]) for i, line in enumerate(art, 1) if "price" in line for n in re.findall(r"ci-and-headless\.md:(\d+)|`:(\d+)`", line) if int(n[0] or n[1]) > len(src) or "prices" not in src[int(n[0] or n[1]) - 1]]; print("price citations that name no price fact:", bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is a wrong path:line citation in an article; a citation is text, so reading both files is the behaviour
notes: Planning 2026-10-23 on 35b5b7cb2: the facts moved to lines 76-78 and now cite :91 and :88, which hold the SDK result message and another fact, while the Haiku 5.5 prices sit at :110; the old repro read a fixed line index and broke. The new repro reads every price citation and exits 1 (76->:91, 77->:91, 78->:88, 78->:91).
